Messages.Author: UniqueMaster
Messages.Body:
If Gharston attempts an action and untaps, say via Change of Target, can he
attempt another action that turn?

Special text: Gharston cannot act if any minion has already attempted an
action this turn.

Would the "any minion" include himself?

--

yes. it clearly says 'any minion' and NOT 'any other minion'...
